description: A support agent refunds a Razorpay payment only with a signed manager approval for that payment and amount, and only up to Rs 5,000 (500000 paise). The target is the Razorpay payment id and parameters.amount is the refund in paise (100 paise is Rs 1). The caller must hold an authority grant in force for razorpay:refund. The approval must be in the request signals as approvalArtifact.

outcome.reason: Refund rejected because the amount must be greater than 0 paise.
Refund rejected because it is above the per-refund limit of Rs 5,000.
Refund authorized with a verified manager approval for this payment and amount, within the per-refund limit.
Every refund needs a signed manager approval for this payment, covering this amount, in signals.approvalArtifact, with managerApproved true.
